response: Use the two trapezoids to make a regular hexagon. Place the upright trapezoid with its 2-unit base as a horizontal line, and place the inverted trapezoid directly below it so that their 2-unit long sides meet along the same horizontal line. On the grid, draw a regular hexagon with side length 1 unit: two horizontal sides (top and bottom), with a horizontal diagonal of length 2 units through the middle, and four slanted sides of 1 unit each. This is a convex 6-sided shape, unlike the concave hexagon in Part B.
